ideas.title: Market-day repair and sharpening corner (market)
ideas.one_liner: Market visitors pay small fixed prices for knife sharpening, hem fixes and small tool repairs while they shop.
steps: Sharpen 15 of your own knives for practice
Book a corner share at one market
Offer $15 small tool repair while-you-shop turnaround
Number-tag every item handed in
Post before/after edges on local groups
Offer a monthly market-day schedule
Add tool repairs as the upsell
